objective: Determine the critical limiting spectral law, or its precise remaining gap, including integer-distance subsequences
model: Fixed d>=3, critically weighted B=sqrt(d-2)AE, H=0, uniform simple regular host, predetermined marks m/n^(1/3)->c>0. The initial target is cubic

ownership.phase_frontier: priority, orchestrator inspection and independent reviews

limits: One bounded research round, at most three concurrent collaborators, bounded source compilation, no external correspondence, submission or unattended runner
checkpoint: Freeze the geometric point process and effective operator before cross-review
stop: Reviewed critical law or a precisely isolated unsupported inference after complementary attempts
exposure: Prior proofs and shared filesystem available to all participants. No blind or access-isolated review is claimed
